context_requirements: RAS/MAPK or PI3K/AKT pathway dependency (e.g., mutant KRAS, NRAS, HRAS, BRAF, or AKT2 overexpression)
active PI3K/AKT2 survival signaling for apoptosis sensitization
intact apoptotic machinery; p53 not strictly required for FTI-induced apoptosis
low baseline RASGRP1/APTX ratio may predict better response in leukemia, not directly applicable here
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any of the nine lines
No induction of apoptosis or stress-response genes at 24 h
No change in CDKN1A or GADD45A/B at either time point
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines including non-RAS-dependent lines
Clear response at 6 h that is not sustained or amplified at 24 h

evidence.supports: FTI-277 inhibits PI3K/AKT2 survival signaling and induces apoptosis in AKT2-overexpressing cancer cells
FTI L-744,832 induces tumor regression via apoptosis and cell-cycle alterations, independent of p53
RASGRP1/APTX expression ratio predicts response to tipifarnib in AML
FTI SCH 66336 suppresses NF-kappaB activation and NF-kappaB-regulated gene expression
FTI-277 radiosensitizes H-ras-transformed cells by increasing apoptosis

changes: Removed NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, and TNIP1 from proximal_up because FTI suppresses NF-kappaB activation, which would decrease rather than increase these NF-kappaB target genes.
Removed TOP2A from proximal_down because it is a generic proliferation gene better placed in late_down.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes from proximal lists: CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B, DDIT4, TRIB3, ATF5, CHAC1, SQSTM1, IER3, ZFP36, DUSP4, CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, MYC, MYBL2, E2F2, TFDP1, CDC25A, CDC25B, PCNA, MCM3, AURKA.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes from late lists: CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B, TSC22D3, SESN1, SFN, PLSCR1, STAT1, UBE2L6, PSMB8, PSMB10, PSME1, PSME2, HMOX1, SQSTM1, CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, BIRC5, PLK1, KIF20A, KIF2C, NUSAP1, STMN1, UBE2C, TOP2A.
Adjusted line_response for A375, A549, HCC515, HT29, MCF7, PC3, and VCAP to weak because these lines lack strong RAS/PI3K dependency or have mutations that may blunt FTI response.
Adjusted line_response for HA1E and HEPG2 to weak due to lack of RAS pathway dependency and intact p53/RB status.
Changed kinetics to slow and magnitude to weak at 6 h and moderate at 24 h to reflect the indirect transcriptional effects of FTI.
Removed PMID 8620483 from evidence because its abstract does not support the stated claim about apoptosis induction; it focuses on radiosensitization.
